claims.evidence: Witness photos show gas cylinders (yellow and blue) but do not show capacity/size markings (kg), label text, or any readable specification.
No certification/inspection markings or expiry date are shown in the witness report.
Photos show dents/scuffs and valve area, but leak status cannot be confirmed from images.
Witness report notes visible valve area/opening, but does not show clear evidence of a newly replaced valve (e.g., new part markings, receipts, or close-up condition).

risks.risk: Cylinder type may not be LPG cooking gas (could be another gas type), making it incompatible with the buyer’s regulator/usage.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s label/stamp showing gas type (e.g., LPG) and any standard markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown gas cylinder (worst-case compatibility risk).

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be smaller/larger), affecting value.
risks.proof: A photo showing the capacity marking (kg) on the cylinder body or valve collar.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not-confirmed capacity (worst-case toward lower capacity).

risks.risk: Certification/inspection may be expired or not present, affecting refill eligibility and safety.
risks.proof: A photo of the certification/inspection stamp and expiry date (or inspection sticker) on the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not certified/unknown certification status.

risks.risk: Leak risk (valve threads, seal, or body damage) cannot be confirmed from photos; dents/scuffs may indicate impact damage.
risks.proof: A short video clip of a leak test (soap-bubble test) around the valve and connections, or proof of recent test documentation.

risks.risk: Regulator/hose compatibility and included accessories are unknown; buyer may need to buy regulator/hose separately.
risks.proof: Photos showing what is included (regulator, hose, fittings) with model/condition, plus close-up of valve outlet threads.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cylinder only (no guaranteed regulator/hose).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it appears (internal corrosion, valve wear) despite external dents/scratches.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the valve threads and interior opening (if safe/allowed) and any corrosion signs, plus any maintenance/refill history documentation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (worst-case).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the cylinder label/stamp showing gas type (LPG) and capacity (kg).
Send photos of certification/inspection markings and the expiry date (or inspection sticker).
Send a short video showing a soap-bubble leak test around the valve and any connection points.
Send close-up photos of the valve threads/outlet and confirm whether a regulator/hose is included (with photos of the exact items).
Send the cylinder’s dimensions/weight markings if available, or a scale photo.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a gas cylinder, but key pricing drivers (capacity, certification/expiry, leak status, and compatibility) are not shown in the report. Without those proof points, any price would be guesswork.
